panelIntro: Version 2 projects are uploaded to your account as drafts for review, and every staff name becomes a new person without any automatic merging. Nothing existing is replaced.
localFound: This device holds data of the previous version: {projects} projects and {people} people.
localNone: This device holds no data of the previous version.
noWriteAccess: Your account may not enter projects, so it cannot upload this data.
laterToast: You can migrate at any time from Settings or the import page.
promptHint: You will see a summary of what will be uploaded before anything changes, and the old data stays on the device until the upload is confirmed.
fileHint: The file exported by version 2 with the “backup” button (istiqama-backup-….json). It is merged as drafts and replaces nothing.
noReplaceNote: The old “import backup” that replaced all data is gone; a file is now only added as drafts.
runInterrupted: Stopped before the end — open it again to continue where it stopped
runWaitingUpload: Saved on the device, waiting for the upload
runWaitingKeys: Uploaded, waiting to remove the old data
checkWaiting: The upload is not complete yet. It is checked again after the next sync.
preparingHint: Reading the data and matching countries, areas and lists. Nothing is saved before you agree.
summaryLead: This is what will be saved to your account. Review it, then start the upload.
nothingNew: All of this data was migrated before; nothing new will be created.
resumed: An earlier attempt with this data stopped; the migration continues where it stopped without duplicates.
ruleDrafts: Every project is saved as a draft for you to review and submit.
ruleNoMerge: Nobody is merged automatically by name: every staff name becomes a new person, and identical names in the same country are sent to a supervisor as a merge suggestion to decide.
ruleSalary: Version 2 did not store a currency for salaries, so they get the country's default currency and the project is flagged for review.
ruleKeys: The old data stays on this device until everything is confirmed on the server, then it is removed.
ruleFile: The file itself is not changed and can be used again without duplicating projects.
phaseSaving: Saving projects and photos on the device…
runningHint: You may hide this window; the migration continues, and if it is interrupted it resumes where it stopped.
reportPartial: {saved} projects saved, {failed} could not be saved.
pushDone: Everything was uploaded to the server.
pushDoneKeys: Everything was uploaded to the server and the old version's data was removed from this device.
pushDoneFile: Everything was uploaded to the server.
pushWaiting: Saved on this device and waiting for the upload ({count} pending operations). It completes by itself when online.
pushWaitingPhotos: Photos not uploaded yet: {count}. The old version's data stays until every photo is uploaded.
mergeReason: Migration from version 2: the name “{name}” appears more than once in the same country. Not merged automatically; check whether it is the same person.
keysKept: The old version's data stays on the device until the upload is confirmed.
pushRejectedHint: The old data stays on the device. Check “needs attention” in the project register, or ask your supervisor for help.
saveFailed: These projects could not be saved on the device:
saveFailedHint: Open the migration again to retry; what was saved is not duplicated.
photoGivenUp: not a valid image, left out
error_reference_missing: The first sync is not complete yet (countries and lists are not on the device). Go online, wait for the sync, then try again.
error_migration_running: Another migration is running. Wait until it ends.
error_nothing_to_migrate: This device no longer holds data of the previous version.
error_unknown: Something went wrong during the migration. Nothing was deleted; try again.
read_malformed_json: The file is damaged or not a JSON file.
read_not_v2: This file is not a version 2 backup.
read_unreadable: The file could not be read.
salaryReviewNote: Migrated from version 2: the salaries had no currency and were recorded in the country's default currency ({currencies}). Please check them.
w_name_missing: No name; a temporary name was given.
w_type_unknown: Unknown type ({value}); recorded as “mosque” for review.
w_location_missing: No location; saved as a draft without a point to complete later.
w_country_mismatch: The point lies outside the country written ({value}); the point was used.
w_area_unknown: The area “{value}” is not in the official list.
w_locality_new: The village “{value}” is new; it will be proposed for a supervisor to approve.
w_locality_skipped: The village “{value}” was not saved because the country is unknown.
w_option_unknown: Values that are not official options were kept as “other”: {value}
w_staff_without_name: A staff row without a name was left out.
w_salary_currency_assumed: Salary recorded in the country's default currency ({value}) for review.
w_salary_no_currency: Salary not saved because the country's currency is unknown ({value}).
w_photo_rejected: A photo was rejected because it is not a valid embedded image.
w_photos_over_limit: More than 10 photos ({value}); the first 10 were migrated.
w_duplicate_v2_id: Duplicate project with the same id ({value}); migrated once.
w_person_without_project: A directory person without a project; saved as a person of its own.
w_person_directory_ambiguous: This directory name belongs to more than one staff member, so its details were not given to any of them.
w_person_possible_duplicate: “{value}” may be a person of another project; saved as a separate person and a merge suggestion was sent to a supervisor.
